title: AI won't make you money. Here's what will.
topic: Why AI on its own doesn't make money - problems do
target_audience: Beginners overwhelmed by 'make money with AI' content
audience_problem: They keep trying tools and earn nothing because there's no customer or offer

beats.voiceover: AI won't make you money. Here's what will.
beats.visual: Tight close-up, straight to camera, slight lean in. Hard cut on 'Here's what will'.

beats.voiceover: Most make-money-with-AI videos show you a tool, then skip the hard part: a real person paying you.
beats.on_screen_text: The skipped step: someone paying you
beats.visual: Quick scroll of generic AI tool logos, blurred (no real brand logos), then back to face.

beats.voiceover: One. Pick a person with a problem. Not 'businesses'. Dog groomers who hate answering messages at night.
beats.visual: Text card '1' pops in. Stock clip of a dog groomer at work, phone buzzing on the counter.

beats.voiceover: Two. Sell the result, not the tool. Nobody wakes up wanting AI. They want fewer missed bookings.
beats.on_screen_text: 2. Sell the result, not the tool
beats.visual: Text card '2'. Split screen: 'AI automation' crossed out vs 'fewer missed bookings' highlighted.

beats.voiceover: So instead of 'I do AI automation', try 'I'll make sure every enquiry gets a reply, even after hours.'
beats.visual: Mock-up of a simple one-line offer on a phone screen (made in Canva, no real business named).

beats.voiceover: Three. Ask for money early. One paying customer teaches you more than ten new tools.
beats.visual: Text card '3'. Back to talking head, finger tap on the word 'early'.

beats.voiceover: Follow for the honest version of AI side hustles.
beats.on_screen_text: Follow for honest AI side hustles
beats.visual: Warm smile, small nod, point down to the follow button.

instagram.caption:
AI is a speed tool, not a business.

What actually gets you paid:
1. A specific person with a specific problem
2. An offer that promises a result, not a tool
3. Asking for payment early

Which step are you stuck on? Tell me in the comments.

No income promises here - just the honest version of AI side hustles.
